gloss: to be absent; to miss (class, a meeting)

definitions.gloss: to be absent; to miss; to not attend
definitions.explanation: To fail to attend or be present at a scheduled event such as class, a meeting, or a ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{欠席|けっせき}します。
⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{欠席|けっせき}した。
examples.english: I was absent from school because of a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}→体調不良：20233_taichoufuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{欠席|けっせき}させて⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I will be absent from tomorrow's meeting due to poor health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日間|みっかかん}{欠席|けっせき}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She has been absent for three days.

notes:
A formal word for being absent from a scheduled event. Commonly used in school and workplace contexts. The noun form ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧ is used on its own in roll calls and attendance records.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{欠席|けっせき}する: to be absent from class
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{欠席|けっせき}する: to be absent from a meeting
- ⟦{欠席届|けっせきとどけ}→欠席届：08080_kessekitodoke⟧: absence notification
- ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧: number of days absent
- ⟦{無断|むだん}{欠席|けっせき}→無断欠席：21256_mudankesseki⟧: unauthorized absence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to take a day off / be absent — more casual and broader; can mean resting or taking leave, not only being absent
- ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend — the direct opposite of {欠席|けっせき}する
- ⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧: absence — describes not being in a particular place rather than missing an event
